groups.change: One caller-linked startup deadline captures source and receiving profiles once, then delegates the captured receiving profile with the independent original lifetime.

Both FR34 handlers require receiver current-head reread/CAS. Result policy binds exact target, common authorization revision, recipe and trust; command policy includes exact consulted caller/principal workload grants, method purposes, revocation and expiry. Unrelated journals remain outside policy. The same policy is checked again after awaited final conditional admission, including nested expiry without a head-byte change.

Connection-owned documented public SQLite VFS implements main IO over its own exact independently enrolled descriptor. DELETE journals use held parent; main descriptor identity and namespace changes are checked inside xOpen. No process-wide FD attribution or private object layout. Per-connection public ABI callbacks are retained through actual native final close.

Private selected input reads use readv directly into one writable bytearray, including a growth sentinel. Every owned region clears on parsing success, faults, growth, cancellation and late reads. No private hashing or immutable os.read chunks.

All three actual qualification Programs acquire a finite receiver owner before authentication/body/JSON/dispatch. One linked acquisition deadline and tracked leaf tasks retain owners through late authenticators, body reads, providers, original writes and response delivery/client loss.

Proof verifier and installed role composition rethrow actual caller cancellation. Composition checks cancellation before missing-input interpretation and through anchor loading before DI registration. Malformed inputs still refuse; internal timeout interpretation remains separate.
Persisted source observer now reads REQUIRED from the single closed_phase_invariants mapping. Full existing source/phase/inventory cases remain unchanged.

Fixed closed-vocabulary process counters distinguish timeout, saturation, actual conditional-save conflict, malformed request/enrolled state, incomplete current enrollment, refusal, storage/handler failures and caller cancellation. No bodies, exceptions, IDs, locators, hashes or untrusted text are stored or emitted; no durable diagnostic IO, queue, timer or external collector.

At-boundary effect and trigger tasks are joined with Task.WhenAll before propagating either failure or collecting ordered observations. Actual receiving workflow keeps the still running trigger and its exact ordinal/input original until settled.

Actual replay registration/receiving/native source commits, then case-result retention fails. A recreated registered workflow recovers through QualificationBoundSourceCaseDriver.LookupAsync, retaining the exact original receipt with unchanged first-seen command bytes/event identity, one native registration, and current exact read scope. Missing stage protocol remains unavailable.
